title: Special Training! Awaken, Soul of Justice!

text_block_list.text:
One day off, while out in the city,
I spotted Biko Pegasus.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go, our Justice Biko~♪
Be the hope of this Earth~♪"
choice_data_list: You're in high spirits. What's up?
You seem cheerful. What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! What a coincidence, Trainer!
I'm actually on my way to some "secret training" right now!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why don't you tag along?
It's gonna be super fun!

Led by Biko Pegasus,
we finally arrived at—
choice_data_list: Is this... an obstacle course park?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Surprised, huh?!
This is my secret training ground!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If you push your body to the limit out in nature,
you'll grow strong like a real hero—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My dad taught me that when I was little,
and we used to train together all the time!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Just like this—hyaaah!

With that, Biko Pegasus scrambled up
a log tower in the blink of an eye!
choice_data_list: Whoa! Impressive!
Whoa! That's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, that's nothing! ...Ooh, that one over there
looks fun too! Let's check it out, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hup, step, leap!
—How's that? 'Wobbly Bridge' cleared!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's keep going straight to the finish...!
You can do it, Trainer! Let's conquer it together!

She cheered me on with absolute sincerity. She must have been training like this
ever since she was small, dreaming of becoming a hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Heheh...
While on my patrol of justice, I heard a hero calling out for help!

...I want to help her fulfill her dream of becoming a hero.
To do that, I'm ready to stick with this "secret training" to the very end.
choice_data_list: You bet! We're just getting started!
Of course! Let's keep going!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's what I'm talking about!
All right, I can't let myself fall behind!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
We did it, course cleared!
Behold our unstoppable power!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That last obstacle was incredible!
Bouldering straight up a wall that looked like a sheer cliff!
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah, totally...!
I-It really was...!

text_block_list.text:
My eyes suddenly caught a sign that read "Expert Course."
Biko Pegasus seemed to notice it as well—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna take on the Expert Course!
...Ah, wait... hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That might be too rough for you, right? Go take a breather in the shade!
I can handle the rest on my own!

Admittedly, for someone who rarely exercised like me,
the previous course was already an intense workout... but still.
choice_data_list: I'm sticking with you all the way!
I'm seeing this through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?!
...N-No, but pushing yourself too hard isn't good, you know?

This is for Biko Pegasus's sake.
I want to watch over her up close while she trains.
choice_data_list: A hero grows stronger alongside their allies!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
O-Oooooh! That sounds super cool!
Alright... Let's do this, Trainer!
From then on, I stayed by Biko Pegasus's side, training until the sun went down—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And to finish things off: BARBECUE TIME!!
Hey, hey, Trainer! Are the grilled carrots...—?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are you okay?
Are you feeling worn out...?

Truth be told, I had pushed myself way too hard trying to keep up.
My exhaustion was undeniable, but...
choice_data_list: I'll be fine once I get some rest, really!
I'll bounce back after a little rest, so I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Are you really?
...Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! I'll handle all the barbecue prep!
So just sit back and relax, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Huh?! But I'd feel bad making you do everything.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it!
You spent all day helping me train!
choice_data_list: Still, I shouldn't be leaning on you like this...
Still, as your trainer, I shouldn't rely on you like this...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying you can't show weakness just 'cause you're the Trainer?
...Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Pegasus PUNCH!
choice_data_list: (She gave me a gentle thud on the chest...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so distant!
Even Trainers are allowed to rely on their horsegirls!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leaning on someone isn't something to be ashamed of!
After all—relying on others is nutrition for the soul!
choice_data_list: Nutrition for the soul...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The greatest hero of all to me...
Carrotman said so himself!

text_block_list.name: Radishman
text_block_list.text:
"Guh, the wounds from that enemy are throbbing...!
Haha, how pathetic of me. Causing you such trouble..."

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"Nonsense, aren't we best friends?
There is no shame in leaning on your allies."

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"To protect as many smiles as possible,
we cannot afford to lose. That is why—"

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"I will rely on my friends to recharge my heart's nutrition!
Now, let us fight together, Radishman!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
When you're feeling down, you borrow strength from your friends to get stronger!
That's how heroes can stand up against any evil!
choice_data_list: Relying on others isn't pathetic after all, huh.
Relying on others isn't pathetic after all, is it?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Exactly!
So—so...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
! ...Yeah, thanks! But I'm fine!
Heroes don't go around relying on others!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: (...Wait? Could it be that I'm...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
choice_data_list: What's wrong, Biko?
What's the matter, Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh—oh, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... So look, it doesn't matter that you're the Trainer.
I want you to rely on me!
choice_data_list: ...You're right, maybe I was pushing myself too hard.
...Yeah, maybe I was pushing myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Just leave tonight to me,
kick back, and enjoy the barbecue!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And then—once our energy is fully recharged,
we'll give training everything we've got again tomorrow!
